title: Introdução à Programação: Conceitos Fundamentais
reason: Substantial 60-hour European-Portuguese programming foundation with structured algorithms, flowcharts and pseudocode plus automatically evaluated programming exercises, making it a serious challenger for the pt-PT computer-science gap.
notes: The public page states NAU certificate and ECTS on meeting requirements, but also carries generic PortugalX/edX migration FAQs. Shallow Screening must verify that the learner-facing NAU route is currently open and determine the exact free certificate/ECTS mechanics before assigning a final access tier.

title: Fundamentos de Bases de Dados
reason: A 25-hour self-paced Portuguese course covering conceptual, logical and physical relational modelling, normalization, SQL, transactions, PostgreSQL and Python integration, with exercises and a participation certificate.
notes: The page also describes synchronous components of the wider PRODIGI programme and reserves 4 ECTS for enrolled PRODIGI students. Shallow Screening must distinguish the open asynchronous MOOC from programme-only contact hours and credits.

title: Estruturas de Dados
reason: A 25-hour self-paced Portuguese specialist course spanning lists, stacks, queues, heaps, hash tables, binary search trees, matrices and graphs, with practical exercises and an explicit minimum completion threshold.
notes: The page is headed 'Avaliação e certificação' and states a 50% minimum score but does not spell out the exact credential wording in the public text inspected. Keep the apparent tier at F1 until Shallow Screening verifies the completion credential.

title: Algoritmos e Complexidade
reason: A 25-hour intermediate Portuguese algorithms course covering time/space complexity, elementary and advanced sorting, divide and conquer, dynamic programming, greedy methods, tree traversal and graph algorithms, with exercises and a completion certificate.
notes: This is a distinct algorithms/theory role rather than another introductory programming course. Shallow Screening should verify prerequisites, full exercise access and current certificate mechanics.

title: Ciência Aberta e Dados FAIR: Princípios, Práticas e Políticas
reason: Current 20-hour Portuguese course on open science, FAIR research-data stewardship, curation, sensitive-data security, research-data policy and responsible AI in science, with six module checks plus a final exam.
notes: The course awards a completion certificate at a 60% threshold and explicitly no ECTS. It targets research-data practice rather than technical machine learning, so it does not close the deeper pt-PT AI/ML gap.

title: Sustentabilidade Ambiental - Mobilizar, Observar e Operacionalizar
reason: A 27-hour Portuguese environmental-sustainability course covering waste, water, energy, air quality and noise through videos, texts, tasks, quizzes and interactive activities, with an explicitly fee-free certificate carrying 1 ECTS.
notes: The unusually strong free-credit claim is explicit on the current official page. Shallow Screening should still verify the live learner route and whether any enrolment constraint exists.

title: Todos Contam — plataforma de e-Learning
provider: Plano Nacional de Formação Financeira / supervisores financeiros portugueses
reason: Official Portuguese financial-education learning platform covering household budgeting, payments, saving and investing, credit, insurance, the economic and financial system and digital finance, with direct regulator involvement.
notes: The public route exposes substantial lesson content but no general completion credential or clearly defined assessment pathway. Finance is currentness-sensitive, so Shallow Screening must audit lesson update dates and current Portuguese legal/regulatory accuracy before advancement.

title: Liderança, Gestão e Valorização de Pessoas
provider: Secretaria-Geral da Educação e Ciência / NAU
reason: A substantial 39-hour Portuguese leadership and people-management course spanning HR, career reflection, emotional intelligence, leadership, team management and competencies, with interactive activities, module quizzes and a completion certificate.
notes: Shallow Screening should verify the live learner route and currency of the management evidence rather than treating duration or public-sector provenance as sufficient quality evidence.

title: Língua portuguesa em contexto de escrita académica
provider: ISCTE - Instituto Universitário de Lisboa / NAU
reason: A 30-hour European-Portuguese academic-writing course covering formal oral and written communication, grammar, punctuation, paragraphing, summaries, synthesis and expository/explanatory writing, with formative assessment and automatic completion certification.
notes: The official page explicitly identifies the European Portuguese variant. It is targeted mainly at students entering higher education, so Deep Review should compare it against broader writing and communication incumbents rather than treating language localisation alone as sufficient.

title: Iniciação à Língua Portuguesa
language_notes: The official course explicitly teaches European Portuguese to complete beginners.
reason: A 32-hour, eight-unit beginner pathway from the University of Porto explicitly teaching European Portuguese for everyday situations, pronunciation, basic vocabulary and grammar, with a final quiz per unit and completion certificate.
notes: This is the strongest current free European-Portuguese learning route found in the scan and directly addresses a language-coverage opportunity. Shallow Screening must verify the current enrolment/completion route and free certificate mechanics.

title: Oferta Pedagógica - Línguas Vivas Estrangeiras
language_notes: Portuguese-framed self-study sampler covering introductory German, Spanish and French (A1) plus English communication at A2/B1; it is not a complete pathway in any one target language.
reason: A permanently open 16-hour Universidade Aberta self-study experience that lets Portuguese-speaking learners begin German, Spanish and French and practise elementary/intermediate English, providing a rare pt-PT instructional bridge into foreign languages.
notes: The 16 hours are shared across four languages and the public page does not expose a credential. Shallow Screening must test instructional completeness aggressively; this may prove too sampler-like for advancement despite its language-access niche.

title: Cidadãos Estrangeiros: Trabalho e Formação
reason: A seven-hour Portuguese specialist course for foreign residents and support professionals on employment access, training, qualification recognition and certification in Portugal, with formal module tests and a participation certificate.
notes: This is a narrow practical public-policy/legal orientation course, not a broad law anchor. Because immigration, labour and recognition procedures can change quickly, Shallow Screening must verify substantive 2026 currentness before any advance decision.
